bio: Give a sharkman a fish, and he'll eat for a day. Teach a sharkman to fish with a giant hook, and he'll become Freeport's greatest fisherman. Bruk's catches are legendary – he once sailed into 80-foot waves in his tiny little skiff and came back with a marlin so big, it fed the entire Free Armada for weeks. Bruk says this is an exaggeration – the waves were only 60-foot.
